page.layout: One column of running text on a single printed page. Running head centred at the top, page number top right. Headings in italic and in large capitals, a rule divides the two sections. No marginal notes. Signature at the bottom left.

main_text.l: Prætores & Consules cum missilia jactant in vul-
gus; wenn sie geben[?] werffen unter das volck/ igno-
rant quid eorum quisq; sit excepturus: & tamē quia
volunt, quod quisq; acceperit ejus esse, statim eum
Dominum efficiunt. §. hoc amplius. inst. eod.[?]

l.i: Cujus est res pro derelicto habita?

main_text.l: Si rem pro derelicto à domino habitam occupa-
verit quis, statim is dominus efficitur. Pro derelicto
autem habetur quod Dominus ea mente abjecerit,
ut id in numero rerum suarum esse nolit: ideoq; sta-
tim Dominus ejus esse desinit. §. qua ratione. insti-
tut.eod.[?]
QUIS EST SECUNDUS
De rebus corporalibus & incorporalibus. Von leiblichen
Quæ sui natura tangi possunt: veluti fundus,
homo, vestis, aurum, argentum, & deniq; aliæ
res innumerabiles §. corporales. inst. eod.[?]
Quæ tangi non possunt: qualia sunt ea, quæ in ju-
re consistunt, sicut hæreditas, usufructus, usus &
obligationes quoquo modo contractæ. §. incorpo-
rales. inst. eod.[?]
Eodem numero sunt jura prædiorum urbanorū,
& rusticorum, quæ etiam servitutes vocantur. §. fi-
nal. inst. eod.[?]

page.notes: No marginal notes. The dashed rule between the two sections is ornament, not text. The reading of the abbreviation "eod." is doubtful in the scan (it may read "cod."), marked [?] throughout. The German in black letter, "wenn sie geben", is partly obscured by overlapping type, so "geben" is doubtful. The signature "G 2" may read differently, and the catchword is absent.
